The '''Dathomiri Shamanism''' was the religion practiced by the [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrothers]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was a ditheistic religion, whose gods were together known as the [[The Ones/Legends|Twin Deities]].

==The Force==
[[Talzin/Legends|Mother Talzin]] completely rejected the idea of [[the Force]]; she instead referred to it as "supernatural powers."

The [[Prophets of the Dark Side]] were similar to the Sith. Their teachings derived from [[Darth Millennial]], though they were not warriors. They claimed to possess powers of [[fortune-telling]]. Talzin doubted their faith and relation to the Spirits.

Groups who have claimed to adhere to traditions include:
*[[Prophets of the Dark Side]]
*[[Kanzer Exiles]]
*[[Sorcerers of Rhand|Rotting Sorcerers of Rhand]]
*[[Mecrosa Order]]
*[[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|The Blackguard]]
*[[Shapers of Kro Var]]

==Services==
It is permissible that [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] receive credits for their services. According to their skills, they can choose one of two specializations: warrior or assassin.

The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] have to go through a harsh training program. If the individual wishes to serve a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], their failure will result in death. Only the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mothers]] may broker the services.
